verdict.rationale: Reflect documents a public API at reflect.academy/api with OAuth2 (including PKCE) authentication and describes capabilities like appending data to notes and listing bookmarked links, plus a separate deep-link URL scheme for triggering in-app commands — both usable for programmatic/AI-driven control. However, probes show no machine-readable spec (openapi.json/swagger.json all 404) and the documented endpoint set is narrow ('a few other things'), suggesting a limited, informally documented API rather than a comprehensive one. Missing for 10: formal OpenAPI/swagger spec, broader documented endpoint coverage, independent/hands-on corroboration of API usage by third-party developers.
